fills.researcher_notes: Searched (Brave, DuckDuckGo lite/html) for 'Dhulian' + 'Daud Khel' + pipeline/SNGPL/transmission. Found only background on the DHULIAN FIELD -- Attock Oil Company discovered oil at Khaur in 1914 and Dhulian followed in 1918 (onepetro.org CMTC-151422-MS abstract; offshore-technology.com Dhulian field profile); Pakistan Oilfields Ltd (not SNGPL) operates local crude/gas gathering lines from Dhulian to Attock Refinery. Per the brief's explicit warning, I am NOT treating the 1914/1918 field-discovery dates as this gas TRANSMISSION pipeline's commissioning year -- a field's age says nothing about when SNGPL laid a distribution/transmission line onward to Daud Khel, and this is exactly the confusion the sweep already flagged on this row. No source (news, SNGPL annual report, OGRA licence) names a 'Dhulian-Daud Khel' SNGPL transmission line with a date. SNGPL's own FY2023-24 annual report and Wikipedia page (lead-only) give only company-level history. Leaving StartYear1 blank -- a genuine dead end, not a substitution of field age for pipeline age.
